name: tabletop-studio
description: Godot 4.6/4.7 headless test suites, 3D visual QA capture, Windows/Android/Web export workflows, EOS P2P smoke checks, Tabletop Hub game scaffolding, and party-style main menu HUD over a live 3D table backdrop.
suggestedPrompts: Run /okey-test to verify all 83 headless test suites and asset guards
Run /qa-capture-3d to capture and inspect the 3D Okey 101 table layout
Run /build-export to check the Android toolchain and export a debug APK
Run /party-menu-hud and /menu-3d-backdrop to rebuild the main menu as a party HUD over the live 3D table
